sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Augmented Counter I is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: 25% increased Counterattack damage.

sections.title: How to Get Augmented Counter I
sections.content: Location: Defeat Bourgeon near Stone Wave Cliffs; Renoir's Drafts merchant.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
